svg.title: Cell reuse and memory refunds have distinct physical owners
svg.desc: Selected native and capability allocation paths precharge the original activation before allocating, including old plus replacement backing during growth. Store and guest-owned allocations retire through actual cleanup. A separate retained result or host-work owner can outlive Store destruction and keeps the same original charge. Only the backend cleanup proof permits cell reuse; uncertain cleanup quarantines it. Memory refunds follow the final physical deallocation, including strong and weak owners and pending work. A safe transfer must sever cell and Store references without refunding retained backing. This is selected allocation accounting, not a complete RSS or kernel-memory bound.
svg.text: Memory follows the original backing owner
Selected Wasmtime and capability paths can retain allocations beyond the Store lifetime.
